data.markdown: **Escalate P1: Confirmed credential harvesting and malicious macro execution risk for user j.okafor**Finance user j.okafor reported an “Invoice overdue” email containing a malicious link and XLSM attachment, confirming they clicked the link on a personal device. Threat intelligence scores the URL and attachment hash as malicious (90/95), and the user has three prior true positive phishing incidents, necessitating immediate escalation due to active compromise indicators and repeat targeting.*   **Threat Intel:** `payroll-update.example-billing.net` tagged phishing/credential-harvesting; SHA256 `9f86d...0a08` tagged maldoc/xlsm-macro; both scored >90 maliciousness. User history includes prior credential submission and malicious attachment TPs.*   **ATT&CK:** T1566.001/002 (Spearphishing Attachment/Link), T1204.001/002 (User Execution).*   **Next Actions:** Escalate to Incident Response immediately. Isolate corporate endpoints, reset credentials, investigate personal device impact, and block the domain/hash organization-wide.
